"Chala Jata Hoon" is a popular song from the 1972 Bollywood movie Mere Jeevan Saathi, featuring Rajesh Khanna and Tanuja. The song is sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar, with music composed by the iconic RD Burman and lyrics written by Majrooh Sultanpuri.
